findings.summary: Carried over from round 1 and still not fixed. The private half of the release-bot key is an ordinary repository secret (AISDLC_SIGNING_KEY), not a secret held in a protected environment, so any workflow that can read repository secrets could sign as release-bot@ai-sdlc.io. Impact is limited today because v3 to v6 envelopes are refused (DEC-0284). Optional follow-up: move the secret into a protected GitHub environment and then mark the entry ciOnly: true (AISDLC-593).
